title: Saag Gosht
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Sarson ka saag (Fresh mustard leaves) 2 kg
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 & ½ tbs
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tbs or to taste

steps.instruction: Clean all the fresh mustard leaves and wash them thoroughly.
steps.romanUrdu: Sarson ka saag ko ache tarhan pani sa dho lein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add water and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein pani dal ker ubal lein.

steps.instruction: Add fresh mustard leaves,green chilies,mix and bring it to boil,cover and boil on medium low flame for 4-5 hours (grind if desired) & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Sarson ka saag aur hari mirch dal ker mix karein aur ubal anay dein phir dhak ker halki darmiyani ancch per 4-5 hours kliya boil ker lein (agar zaroorat ho tou grind ker lein) & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add mustard oil,cloves,cinnamon sticks,whole black pepper,green cardamom,black cardamom, cumin seeds and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein sarson ka tail,laung,darchini,sabut kali mirch,hari elaichi,badi elaichi aur zeera dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add beef boneless cubes and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Beef boneless cubes dal dein aur rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add onion,mix well and cook for 10-12 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 10-12 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste and mix well for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker 2 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add coriander powder,turmeric powder,red chili powder,salt,mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhania powder,haldee powder,lal mirch powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein aur 5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add water,mix well and bring it to boil,cover and cook on low flame for 25-30 minutes or until meat is tender.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker mix karein aur ubal anay ka bad dhak dein aur halki ancch per 25-30 minutes ya gosht gul janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add tomatoes and mix well,cover and cook until tomatoes are soft and oil separates.
steps.romanUrdu: Tamatar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker tamatar naram hunay aur oil alag hunay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Now add boiled fresh mustard leaves,mix well and cook for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab boiled sarson ka saag dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 8-10 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add green garlic,green chili,fresh coriander and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Hara lehsan,hari mirch aur hara dhania dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with green chili,green garlic & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Hari mirch aur hara lehsan sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: Enjoy Saag Gosht in typical Sindhi style, serve it with chawal ka chilla (Rice chilla) and enjoy your winter. #HappyCookingToYou
